capabilities: Suggest missing inline wiki-links for the current note or whole vault
Preview graph impact of accepted links before writing them
Explore the vault as a semantic vector space with PCA note and concept views
Choose exact matches, AI matches, or both per vault-wide scan
Exclude or retarget noisy suggestions from review rows
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a fully automatic linker; AI suggestions start unselected and require acceptance in review before anything is written.
extras: Desktop-only. The default embedding model downloads from Hugging Face on first use and then runs on-device; no cloud service or telemetry is involved. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's graph view shows the links you already made. Semantic Auto-Linker also shows the relationships your vault implies.
problem: Obsidian's graph only shows links you already made, so implied relationships between unlinked notes in large vaults stay hidden and must be found manually.
summary: Link suggestion plugin that finds missing wiki-links with review-before-write and explores the vault as a semantic vector space.
